clusters.name: After Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within months of Bea's birth in March 1995, your mother's anxiety rose as she was worn out with the baby. By late 1995 your parents were distant, your father working late most nights. Around the same time your stomach aches began and you started missing school. Your brother Jonah's conflict with your father flared up in spring 1996, and by fall your mother had stopped working altogether, her functioning down. Five shifts that count piled up within a year and a half around the arrival of a third child into the family.
